main.description: A repository's settings, read from its dev.knotless.repo record as its PDS has it now, for the pages' settings to show and change. All of it is public, as the record is.

collaborators.description: The accounts that may push to it.

defaultBranch.description: The branch its record names for HEAD, without refs/heads/.

delegated.description: The gateway its owner delegated writes to from this appview's pages (dev.knotless.delegateWrites), which sharing it for writing names as its gateway; absent until they have.

description.description: What the repository says it is.

gates.description: The accounts its protected branches' rules name as gates (dev.knotless.repo#reviews), each once: for the pages to show by handle. Absent when there are none.

gateway.description: The gateway the owner delegated writes to, through which collaborators push: absent until the owner delegates.

indexed.description: Deprecated, and no longer set: knotless.dev indexes every private repository its members read there. Was, for a private repository, whether its owner let this appview keep an index of it.

labels.description: The labels its pulls and issues may carry.

links.description: The links its pages show, in order, as its record names them.

readers.description: For a private repository, asked by its owner, the members who read it but do not push to it, its runners among them; absent for a public one, which anyone reads, and empty to anyone else.

runners.description: Whether it names a runner, which the merge queue needs to land it. Absent when it names none.

storage.description: Deprecated, and no longer set: dev.knotless.getRepoStorage counts it, apart, as counting reads every pack record from the PDS. Was what it takes up on its owner's PDS.

topics.description: What it is about, in order, as its record names them.

transfer.description: Where the owner has offered to move it, if they have: the account, and the name it would have there.

triagers.description: The accounts whose labels of some scopes count.

uri.description: Its dev.knotless.repo record, under the name it has now.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

storageView.description: A repository's packs, which hold all of its history, as `knotless repo storage` counts them.

blobBytes.description: Of those, the bytes in blobs rather than inline in records.

bytes.description: Their bytes, as git packs them.

objects.description: The objects in them, pack by pack: one in two packs counts twice, until compaction folds them.

triagerView.description: An account whose labels of some scopes count on a repository.

scopes.description: The scopes of the labels it may put on.

description: What a repository's owner sets: its description, links, topics and default branch, protected branches, labels, collaborators and triagers, and an offer to move it.
